name: 2026 SMU-Jinan Conference on Urban and Regional Economics, joint with the 11th WB-GWU Urbanization and Development Conference
organizer: Singapore Management University School of Economics and Jinan University, with the World Bank and George Washington University
submission_requirements: Full papers or extended abstracts (priority to full papers); priority to work on urbanization and development in the developing world and studies relevant to developed or developing Asia
registration_fee: SGD 500 regular / SGD 250 students (in-person, excl. GST, incl. conference dinner)
keynotes: Thomas Chaney (USC); Melanie Morten (Stanford); Paul Novosad (Dartmouth); Steve Redding (Stanford)
